nodes.label: ADR-008 — Narrow Ports Replace IBridge Aggregate
nodes.rationale: Interface segregation at consumer boundary: a use case reading one file should not depend on a type exposing notifications and settings. One class per runtime (not one file per port × runtime) avoids shared internal store and boilerplate. Port additions happen alongside their first consumer so interface can be validated by tests from the start.

nodes.label: Narrow Ports Pattern (SettingsPort, VaultPort, WorkspacePort, NotificationPort, LoggerPort)

edges.source_location: each runtime one class implementing all ports

hyperedges.label: Runtime-Ports Triad: bridge implementations + narrow ports + DDD layered architecture together decouple Obsidian from domain and UI
